from.description:
The DID of the principal who sent the offer. `receive` keeps an offer only
when this is the event's actor, which nothing in the payload can choose.

host.description: The origin of the host serving that space.

id.description:
The sender's key for the offer; no two offers in the inbox from one sender
share one.

kind.description: What is offered, such as `loom` or `fabrichat-room`.

ownerOrigin.description: The origin of the sender's own host, or empty.

receivedAt.description:
When the inbox received the offer, in milliseconds since the epoch. A
handler's clock reads to the second, so two offers can share it.

sharedAt.description:
When the sender shared the offer, in milliseconds since the epoch, by the
sender's clock, or by the inbox's when the sender named no time.

space.description: The DID of the space the offered thing lives in.

title.description: What the sender calls the offered thing, or empty.

from.description: The DID of the sender, which must be the principal sending the event.

host.description: The origin of the host serving that space, such as `https://example.com`.

id.description:
The sender's key for the offer, the same on every resend of it. The inbox
keeps one offer per sender and `id`.

kind.description:
What is offered, such as `loom` or `fabrichat-room`. A reader acts only on
the kinds it knows.

ownerOrigin.description: The origin of the sender's own host, if it names one.

sharedAt.description: When the sender shared the offer, in milliseconds since the epoch.

space.description: The DID of the space the offered thing lives in.

title.description: What the sender calls the offered thing.

offers.description: The offers received, labeled readable by the inbox's owner alone.

receive.description: Appends an offer from the principal sending it, unless it is refused.
